headline: A fresh global usage reset is complete
scope: Global reset; eligible plans and usage windows were not separately specified.

announcement.text: Put the reset in the bag. All propagated.

previousAnnouncement.text: Global reset by EOD. May the tokens do good things for you.
previousAnnouncement.translation: 将在当天结束前进行全局重置。愿这些 token 帮你做出好东西。

note: Tibo quoted the global-reset announcement and confirmed full propagation. The recorded time is the public confirmation time, to minute precision, not the backend execution time. The earlier EOD announcement did not specify a timezone. Neither post separately specifies eligible plans or usage windows. This does not confirm delivery of the earlier Day 3 banked reset.
